title: Unveiling Hidden Vulnerabilities in Digital Human Generation via Adversarial Attacks
keywords: expressive human pose and shape estimation (EHPS)
core_idea: Expose hidden vulnerabilities in digital human generation systems by applying adversarial attacks, with a focus on expressive human pose and shape estimation (EHPS).
tldr: Apply adversarial attacks to digital human generation, targeting EHPS, to unveil hidden system vulnerabilities.
